## Notes

- Source-only package (`@wowlab/shared`) consumed directly by [`apps/landing`](../../apps/landing/) and [`apps/studio`](../../apps/studio/). No build step.
- Every public module is an explicit entry in the `exports` map in `package.json`. Add new files there. There are no `tsconfig` path aliases and no barrel-everything re-exports.
- Holds shared UI (`components/ui`, `components/common`, `components/content`), library code (`lib/`), markdown content (`content/`), and all translations (`i18n/`).
- Copy is wired through intlayer (`i18n/`). Load the `intlayer` skill before touching strings.
